product.name: 3 Day Taman Safari Prigen, Bromo & Madakaripura Family Tour from Surabaya
product.seoTitle: 3 Day Taman Safari, Bromo & Madakaripura Family Tour | JVTO
product.seoDescription: Private 3-day family tour from Surabaya: Taman Safari Prigen, Mount Bromo sunrise, Madakaripura Waterfall. All-inclusive. Best for families with children.
product.description: Private 3-day family tour from Surabaya: Taman Safari Prigen, Mount Bromo sunrise, Madakaripura Waterfall. All-inclusive. Best for families with children.

keyExperiences.name: Mount Bromo
keyExperiences.highlight: Sunrise over Tengger Caldera and sacred Hindu ceremonies

keyExperiences.name: Madakaripura Waterfall
keyExperiences.highlight: Sacred 200-meter canyon waterfall and Gajah Mada's meditation site

inclusions: Private Transport: Air-conditioned private vehicles (MPV for 1-3 guests, Minibus for 4-11 guests) with a dedicated driver. This includes fuel, tolls, and parking fees.
Tour Guides: Experienced English-speaking guides. For 1-3 guests, a driver-guide. For 4+ guests, a separate local guide will be provided at each main destination (Bromo, Ijen, Madakaripura).
JVTO Travel T-Shirt: One complimentary JVTO branded T-shirt per person on every confirmed booking. Available in sizes XXS–XXL. Groups of 10+ pax receive a custom-designed group T-shirt.
Full Assistance: From your arrival to your final drop-off.
Quality Hotel Accommodation: including daily breakfast.
All Entrance Fees & Permits: to attractions
Meals: As mention in the itinerary
Private 4WD Jeep: For the Mount Bromo sunrise tour.
Gas Mask: Professional volcanic-grade gas mask provided for Ijen Crater routes. Mandatory during descent to crater floor due to H₂S/SO₂ gas.
exclusions: International/Domestic Air Tickets: To and from your tour's starting and ending points.
Travel Insurance: Optional but highly recommended for peace of mind, covering trip interruptions, medical emergencies, and lost luggage.
Meals Not Stated in Itinerary: Specific lunches and additional dinners are at your own expense.
Personal Expenses: Such as snacks, souvenirs, beverages, laundry, etc. It is recommended to carry at least IDR 500,000 per person for these.
Tips: For drivers and guides (at your discretion).

itineraryDays.title: Surabaya to Taman Safari Prigen and Continue Toward Bromo
itineraryDays.summary: The first day begins with the safari segment before the route continues toward the Bromo side for overnight staging. It gives the itinerary a broader entry point than a volcano-only route while keeping the next day's timing stable.

activities.description: Pick up at your hotel in Surabaya and depart for Prigen Safari Park. This is the transfer segment from Surabaya to the safari destination to begin the day’s planned visit.

activities.name: Safari Adventure at Prigen
activities.description: Arrive at Prigen Safari Park and start the Safari Adventure. This is the main safari visit window, allocated for entering the park and following the planned safari activities during your time on-site.

activities.name: Lunch at Safari Area
activities.description: Lunch inside the safari area (fees not included). This is the scheduled lunch break within the park area, allowing time to order and dine before continuing the day’s onward travel.

activities.name: Transfer to Bromo Area
activities.description: Finish at Taman Safari and begin the journey to the Bromo area. This segment marks the transition from the safari visit to the overland transfer toward your Bromo-area accommodation.

activities.name: Check-in at Bromo Hotel

itineraryDays.title: Bromo-side Overnight and Final Sunrise Preparation
itineraryDays.summary: The second day holds the route on the Bromo side so the sunrise sequence can be handled well the next morning. This middle section keeps the trip paced for families and mixed-interest groups rather than forcing unnecessary compression.

itineraryDays.summary: The final day combines the Bromo sunrise sequence with the Madakaripura stop before returning to Surabaya. It gives the route a strong East Java finish while staying more accessible than the harder volcanic combinations.
